author: Böhlke & Caldwell, 1961

note.en: A small sand stargazer that FishBase lists only from Costa Rica and Panama; no habitat or place on this coast was found, so it is a record only (depth range approximate).
note.es: Un miraestrellas de arena pequeño que FishBase lista solo para Costa Rica y Panamá; no se encontró hábitat ni sitio en esta costa, así que es solo un registro (rango de profundidad aproximado).

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
No locality on this coast was found
